shen_smith.source_location: Final article Sections II.B-II.C, III.A-III.B, Data Availability; Supplemental Table S1 DAC-1 and DAC-2.
shen_smith.rights: Final article prints copyright 2026 American Physical Society. Official supplement landing page requires subscription. No separate open data grant located; availability is not permission.
shen_smith.assessment: Homogeneous primary numerical measurements/derived lattice volumes from two purpose-run experiments, with in-measurement peak fitting/uncertainty generation and pressure-drift checks. The distributed flat CSV contains numerical values, errors and ordinary row/phase labels, not artwork, article prose, source-sheet layout or software. The paper describes experimental data creation; no separate substantial collection investment independent of that creation was established in the inspected evidence. Full-collection reuse is acknowledged and is not characterized as insubstantial. This remains a reasoned maintainer assessment, not proof that qualifying independent investment or acquisition restrictions are absent.
limits: Data creation is not a categorical database-rights exemption; independent verification/presentation investment can still qualify.
Author affiliation or funding is not used to infer nationality, EU eligibility, public-domain status or permission.
Acquisition/subscription contracts have not been exhaustively audited.
No EOS coefficient, selection mask, fit label or recommendation is changed.

aip_copper.ancestry: Table 4d-12 contains calculated 25 C isotherms reduced from selected shock data; section 4d-2 cites van Thiel, Compendium of Shock Wave Data, UCRL-50108 (1966). aip_copper.assessment: Limited Cu-only numerical excerpt in normalized pressure/ratio columns, not a copy of the handbook table design, other columns, captions or prose. Functional ascending pressure sequence and numerical results are assessed separately from protected expression. The fixed 1972 collection predates the German 1983 transitional window; no later revised database is used. This supports the numerical admission, not an assertion that the handbook is public domain.
scientific_limits: 25 C = 298.15 K; these are shock-reduced calculated isotherm entries, not direct static observations.
Printed 09900 at 15 kbar remains interpreted as 0.9900 with the existing explicit note.
Blank Cu cells at 5 and 10 kbar remain absent; no zero-pressure anchor or uncertainty is added.

legal_framework.scope: Original scientific expression may be protected; numbers are not categorically exempt just because they appear in a scientific table.
Substantial independent obtaining, verification or presentation investment can create database-maker rights; substantive changes with new qualifying investment can create a new database.
German database-maker rights have a fifteen-year term, subject to the statutory calculation rule.
German transitional protection covers databases made 1983-1997 with a term starting 1 January 1998. This is relevant to the fixed 1989 table, not a blanket expiry of article copyright.

C-203/02 paragraphs 31-36 distinguish creating data from qualifying database investment, including the independent-verification/presentation qualification. Only official indexed excerpts were available; direct endpoints returned challenge/empty content.
Compilation copyright does not extend ownership to pre-existing material; functional mathematical/scientific content is assessed separately from protected arrangement.
Separate facts, original selection/arrangement, sheet layout and independent database rights. No universal row-count threshold or automatic experimental-data exemption.
